goal: Diagnose and fix existing order/payment routes, add missing user pages (order history, payment status, product detail), build or refine their EJS views with clear UI/UX, and verify the end-to-end user flow works.
summary:
Phase 1 (Fix User-Facing Integration) completed successfully.
- Diagnosed existing integration issues (diagnosis-report.md).
- Built centralized API client config (frontend/config/api.js).
- Fixed payment upload middleware (payment-service/middleware/upload.js).
- Implemented GET /orders route + orders.ejs view with Tailwind badges, empty state, and action buttons.
- Implemented GET /products/:id route + product-detail.ejs view with back navigation and "Order This Design" CTA.
- Implemented GET /payments route + payments.ejs view with status card, specs grid, and contextual CTAs.
- Polished existing order.ejs and payment.ejs with nav links, English labels, help tips, and status badge mapping.
- Ran end-to-end manual test: login → products → product detail → place order → order history → payment status. All pages returned 200 with clear visual feedback and graceful error handling.
- Wrote e2e-verification-report.md documenting results.

Deferred to next phases: /admin/orders (admin order & payment management), /gallery, /recommendation, and INTEGRATION_REPORT.md.
stepSummaries:
1. Diagnose current failures: run frontend with backend services, test existing /order, /payment, /products routes and capture exact errors or missing functionality. [verified]
  2. Fix any connectivity or data-format issues in existing order and payment route handlers (POST /order, POST /payment). [verified]
  3. Add GET /orders route calling /api/orders/user/:userId via API Gateway and render a clean order-history EJS view with table/list layout, clear status labels, and empty-state message. [verified]
  4. Add GET /products/:id route calling /api/products/:id via API Gateway and render a clear product-detail EJS view with back navigation, product specs, and an order CTA. [verified]
  5. Add GET /payments route (or similar) calling /api/payments/order/:orderId to display payment status in a readable EJS view with current status, amount, and next steps. [verified]
  6. Review and improve UI/UX of existing order.ejs and payment.ejs views: ensure labels are intuitive, form guidance is clear, navigation cues (e.g., breadcrumbs or back links) are present, and flash messages are styled/readable. If a view does not exist yet, create it with consistent styling. [verified]
  7. Run end-to-end manual test: login → browse products → place order → upload payment → view order history. Confirm every step has clear visual feedback. [verified]
